SELECT DATE(created_at) AS date, COUNT(*) AS publishedJobs, COUNT(DISTINCT company_id) AS activeEnterprises FROM jobs WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(created_at)
SELECT DATE(created_at) AS date, COUNT(*) AS newWorkers FROM c_worker WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(created_at)

SELECT DATE(applied_at) AS date, COUNT(*) AS applications, COUNT(DISTINCT worker_id) AS activeWorkers FROM schedule_applications WHERE applied_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(applied_at)

SELECT e.id AS enterpriseId, e.company_name AS enterpriseName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jobs j WHERE j.company_id = e.id) AS jobCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schedule_applications sa JOIN job_schedules js ON sa.schedule_id = js.id WHERE js.job_id IN (SELECT id FROM jobs WHERE company_id = e.id)) AS applicationCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ar.payable_pay), 0) FROM attendance_records ar WHERE ar.company_id = e.id AND ar.settlement_status = 'PAID') AS totalSettlement FROM enterprises e ORDER BY applicationCount DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT w.id AS workerId, w.name AS workerName, w.phone AS workerPhone, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance_records ar WHERE ar.worker_id = w.id AND ar.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'ON_DUTY', 'LATE')) AS completedJobs, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ar.payable_pay), 0) FROM attendance_records ar WHERE ar.worker_id = w.id AND ar.settlement_status = 'PAID') AS totalEarnings FROM c_worker w WHERE w.id IN (SELECT DISTINCT worker_id FROM attendance_records WHERE worker_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY totalEarnings DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT c.name AS category, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(j.headcount), 0) FROM jobs j WHERE j.category_id = c.id AND j.status = 'PUBLISHED') AS demand, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schedule_applications sa JOIN job_schedules js ON sa.schedule_id = js.id JOIN jobs j2 ON js.job_id = j2.id WHERE j2.category_id = c.id) AS supply FROM job_categories c WHERE c.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY demand DESC
